Strikes a block in your aim (up to 32 blocks).
tooltip.elementalstaves.earth_staff.1: Use on a block to select it; use a face to move it.
tooltip.elementalstaves.earth_staff.2: Sneak-use to replace selection. Cost: 3 durability.
message.elementalstaves.lightning.no_tar: §eThe Lightning Staff needs a block target within 32 blocks.

message.elementalstaves.earth.not_movabl: §cThis block cannot be moved by the Earth Staff.
message.elementalstaves.earth.selected: §aBlock selected. Use a block face to move it into the adjacent empty space.
message.elementalstaves.earth.too_far: §eSource and target must be near you and within 16 blocks of one another.
message.elementalstaves.earth.invalid_de: §cThe block cannot be moved outside the world border.
message.elementalstaves.earth.destinatio: §eThe destination must be empty and valid for this block.
